page_note: 沃尔玛季度业绩演示第9页，左侧为员工照片，右侧标题「Returns to shareholders」下为一张按季度堆叠柱状图（股息与股票回购），图下有合计行，右侧配两条要点文字。

heading.title: Returns to shareholders
heading.subtitle: Through dividends and share repurchases
heading.unit_text: Amounts in billions, except as noted.  Dollar changes may not recalculate due to rounding.

components.evidence: each quarter's bar has a blue Dividends segment below a yellow Share repurchases segment
only a horizontal baseline under the bars; no ticks or gridlines on the value axis
"$1.5" printed inside each blue segment, "$1.2", "$0.7", "$0.5" inside yellow segments
"$0.1" sits above the thin Q3 FY24 yellow segment, outside the mark
the Q3 FY24 yellow segment is very thin so its "$0.1" label moved above it
"Dividends" and "Share repurchases" swatches sit in a row under the category axis
row labelled "Returns to shareholders" with $2.7, $2.2, $2.0, $1.6, $3.0 under the axis
bullets "Share repurchases during the quarter totaled $1,497 million" in a column right of the plot
category ticks read "Q4 FY23", "Q1 FY24" instead of ISO dates
"Amounts in billions, except as noted." line under the title fixes the scale

new_components.name: row_label_in_tinted_box
new_components.evidence: the "Returns to shareholders" total-row label sits in a light grey filled box left of the values
new_components.why_it_matters: 合计行的行名在灰底方框内且与图标题同名，解析时容易被当作标题或漏掉，导致$2.7等合计值无行名可寻址。

new_components.name: total_row_duplicates_title_text
new_components.evidence: the totals row label "Returns to shareholders" repeats the slide title verbatim
new_components.why_it_matters: 同一字符串既是页标题又是行标签，检索合计值时无法区分上下文，需要额外的季度列名共同定位。

difficulty_notes: 数值本身全部印在图上（$1.5、$1.2、$0.1等），且没有值轴，所以读数不成问题；难点在寻址：Dividends 在五个季度里都是 $1.5，Q4 FY24 的两个分段又同为 $1.5，单靠数值无法区分，必须同时带上季度列名与系列名两把钥匙；此外 $2.7/$1.6/$3.0 属于轴下合计行，其行标签「Returns to shareholders」与页标题字面完全相同，解析器若把该行并入柱体表格或丢掉灰底行名，这三个值就没有唯一可用的行名。

suggestions.what_to_add: total_row_below_axis（轴下合计行）作为独立的记录字段与样式维度
suggestions.where_to_change: 图表记录结构中新增 totals_row 字段（行名+每类别值），并在导出markdown时作为表格最后一行输出
suggestions.new_ablation_row: 有/无轴下合计行时，合计值（$2.7、$1.6、$3.0）被正确寻址的召回率对比

suggestions.what_to_add: thin_segment_label（细分段标签外移）与 value_label_inside/outside 混用
suggestions.where_to_change: 样式字段中的 value-label placement 改为按分段高度自适应：低于阈值时移到分段外
suggestions.new_ablation_row: 标签一律置内 vs 细分段自动外移时，$0.1 这类小值的读取正确率对比

suggestions.what_to_add: no_value_axis（无值轴，仅基线）作为可控条件
suggestions.where_to_change: 条件行中增加「无刻度值轴+全部数值标注」这一组合
suggestions.new_ablation_row: 有刻度轴 vs 仅基线+全标注两种条件下的取值精度对比

suggestions.what_to_add: 标题四段拆分（title / subtitle / unit_text «Amounts in billions, except as noted.»）
suggestions.where_to_change: 标题记录字段拆为 number、title、subtitle、unit、placement 五项
suggestions.new_ablation_row: 单一标题串 vs 拆分标题时，单位「in billions」能否被关联到 $1.5 等数值

suggestions.where_to_change: 页面版式条件中新增「图与正文共享一条水平带」的布局行
suggestions.new_ablation_row: 有/无侧栏文字时，图内数值与正文数值（$1,497 million）是否被混淆的错配率
